💡 twig | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A user-friendly desktop application for managing Git repositories with advanced visualization and operational features.
✨ Key Features: • Real commit graph with virtualized, paginated view • Uncommitted work at a glance with staging and diff views • Sidebar for repository navigation (LOCAL/REMOTE/TAGS) • Commit panel with full message, author card, parents, and changed files
📖 Summary: Twig is a standalone desktop Git client for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built with Electron, React, and Vite. It offers a comprehensive interface for managing Git repositories, focusing on visualizing commit history, staging changes, and executing various Git operations through an intuitive user experience.
